game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Vanucci33
quote: Grand Theft Auto has spent decades turning crime into spectacle: steal the car, make the money, buy the upgrade, escape the cops. Its satire can be sharp, but it often gets tangled up in the same things it claims to mock. Drugs become edgy set pieces, violence becomes routine, and materialism becomes the reward loop. After so many games, the provocation feels less like a critique and more like a familiar sales pitch.That history makes GTA 6’s return to the same world hard to celebrate. A bigger map or slicker satire won’t mean much if the series still treats crime as entertainment and consumerism as aspiration. 0/10 for a franchise that keeps confusing depicting excess with having something to say about it.
